title: Mitigating BGP Route Flap Damping & Hold-Timer Oscillations on PE-CE Uplinks
trigger_precursors: BGP prefix churn rate > 25 updates/min
Hold-timer jitter variance > 4.5s
BGP session state flapping between Established and OpenSent/Active
Carrier Keepalive packet latency drift
technical_root_causes: Physical carrier Metro-E optical degradation causing intermittent frame drops
BGP hold-timer expiration due to high control-plane CPU queue starvation
MTU mismatch on sub-interface causing jumbo frame drops during route updates
Route flap damping penalty threshold exceeded on service provider PE
preventive_remediation_steps: 1. Soft-reconfigure BGP neighbor session with dynamic route-refresh: 'neighbor <peer-ip> soft-reconfiguration inbound'.
2. Tune BGP hold-time timer to 90s and keepalive to 30s to prevent premature session drops during brief carrier packet drops.
3. Shift latency-critical overlay traffic to secondary redundant CE uplink via BGP Local Preference (set LP 200 on backup, 100 on primary).
4. Trigger automated SD-WAN Dynamic Multipoint IPSec SLA steering policy override to favor secondary Hub.

title: MPLS Traffic Engineering (MPLS-TE) Auto-Route LSP Redirection for Core Trunk Saturation
trigger_precursors: Interface utilization rising with positive linear regression drift (predicted >95% within 180s)
Buffer queue depth > 65% with increasing microburst frequency
WRED (Weighted Random Early Detection) early drop threshold engagement
Core trunk bandwidth consumption delta > 15 Gbps/min
technical_root_causes: Elephant flow backup synchronization initiated without QoS bandwidth shaping
Single transit trunk congestion due to unbalanced ECMP hash distribution
Trans-continental core fiber trunk capacity exhaustion during regional peak hours
preventive_remediation_steps: 1. Calculate alternate explicit RSVP-TE LSP (Label Switched Path) via secondary P-Core router (P-CORE-02).
2. Re-optimize MPLS-TE Tunnel Auto-Route metric: 'tunnel mpls traffic-eng path-option 1 explicit TE-SECONDARY-PATH'.
3. Engage CoS Scavenger class (CS0) rate-policing on ingress CE to throttle non-critical elephant flows to 20% capacity.
4. Distribute IPFIX elephant flows across multi-chassis LAG bundle.

title: IPSec Dead Peer Detection (DPD) & Dynamic Crypto SA Rekey Latency Remediation
trigger_precursors: Progressive packet loss drift from 0.05% towards 2.5% on DMVPN tunnel
IKEv2 / IPsec Security Association (SA) re-key latency drift > 850ms
Anti-replay window sequence number drops detected
Crypto engine hardware crypto buffer saturation
technical_root_causes: Underlay MPLS path jitter causing IKEv2 DPD keepalive acknowledgment delays
Hardware crypto acceleration co-processor queue congestion
Re-key phase collision between Hub and multiple Branch CEs simultaneously
WAN MTU fragmentation of encrypted ESP packets
preventive_remediation_steps: 1. Pre-emptively trigger graceful crypto SA rekey: 'clear crypto sa peer <hub-ip> soft'.
2. Enable Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD) and set TCP MSS adjust to 1360 on overlay tunnel interfaces: 'ip tcp adjust-mss 1360'.
3. Activate Forward Error Correction (FEC) and Adaptive Packet Duplication on overlay tunnel for voice (EF) packets.
4. Adjust DPD keepalive interval to 10s with 3 retries.

title: Interface Queue Buffer Exhaustion & WRED Random Drop Tuning
trigger_precursors: Buffer discards rate accelerating (>150 drops/sec)
High-priority VoIP EF queue depth > 45%
Memory allocation pool exhaustion for packet buffers on linecard
Burst duration exceeding hardware packet-memory limit
technical_root_causes: Microburst collision from synchronized application backup bursts
Misconfigured QoS queue scheduling weights (strict priority starvation)
Egress port speed mismatch (100G ingress feeding 10G egress interface)
preventive_remediation_steps: 1. Dynamic QoS Buffer Expansion: Adjust hardware queue-limit multiplier by +50% for burst absorption.
2. Apply ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification) marking to initiate TCP window reduction at endpoints.
3. Prioritize Low Latency Queueing (LLQ) bandwidth allocation for VoIP and Video streams.
4. Divert bulk replication traffic to off-peak staging queue.

title: SD-WAN Application-Aware SLA Steering for Real-Time VoIP/Video Jitter Drift
trigger_precursors: Voice MOS score degradation projection (< 3.8 estimated in 120s)
Overlay jitter drifting past 8.0ms threshold
Underlay carrier packet latency increasing monotonically (+2ms/min)
technical_root_causes: Carrier regional peering exchange point congestion
Asymmetric routing between forward and reverse transit paths
Underlay Metro-E radio link degradation in inclement weather
preventive_remediation_steps: 1. Trigger Application-Aware Routing (AAR) SLA policy shift to alternate secondary Hub overlay tunnel.
2. Enable per-packet load sharing across redundant IPSec tunnels with active re-ordering buffer.
3. Alert Voice Engineering team with automated telemetry diagnostic bundle.

title: Datacenter Interconnect (DCI) Heartbeat Asymmetry & Dual-Active Split-Brain Prevention
trigger_precursors: DCI cross-connect heartbeat latency variance > 1.5ms
BGP EVPN MAC/IP route synchronization delta > 250 routes
Optical transceiver Rx power degradation on 10G DCI interface
technical_root_causes: Intra-datacenter fiber patch cable micro-bend or transceiver optical loss
Control plane CPU spike on secondary DC CE delaying keepalive exchange
Spanning-tree BPDU filter misconfiguration causing temporary port blocking
preventive_remediation_steps: 1. Lock Active state on DC1-CE-01 to prevent flapping election cycles.
2. Route DCI sync heartbeat over secondary out-of-band MPLS VRF transit path.
3. Suppress BGP EVPN route-withdrawn timers by +30s to allow convergence.
4. Dispatch on-site DC technician with optical power meter to inspect TenGigabitEthernet0/1/0.
